# Laval (QC)

Support for schedules provided by [Laval (QC)](https://www.laval.ca).

Source for collection calendars in Laval, Quebec, Canada.

## Configuration via configuration.yaml

```yaml
waste_collection_schedule:
  sources:
    - name: laval_ca
      args:
        matricule: MATRICULE
        codeZone: CODEZONE
```

### Configuration Variables

**matricule**  
*(string) (required)*

**codeZone**  
*(string) (required)*

## Example

```yaml
waste_collection_schedule:
  sources:
    - name: laval_ca
      args:
        matricule: 8546-45-9730-2-000-0000
        codeZone: '12'
```

## How to get the source arguments

Enter your property roll number (matricule) and collection zone (codeZone). If you do not know them, look up your address at https://www.laval.ca/recherche-par-adresse/.
